# arm — 2018 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 7 arm CVEs of 2018 are in `data/cve/vendors/arm/2018.jsonl`.

### CVE-2018-25423 — Arm Whois 3.11 Denial of Service via Buffer Overflow
- Assigner: VulnCheck | Published: 2026-05-30 | Updated: 2026-06-01 | Max CVSS: 6.9
- CWE: CWE-120 Buffer Copy without Checking Size of Input ('Classic Buffer Overflow')
- CVSS 4.0 (cna): 6.9 MEDIUM `CVSS:4.0/AV:L/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:N/VI:N/VA:H/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N`
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 6.2 MEDIUM `CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=poc, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=partial

Arm Whois 3.11 contains a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows local attackers to crash the application by supplying an oversized input string. Attackers can paste a malicious buffer of 700 bytes into the IP address or domain input field to trigger a denial of service condition.

Affected:
- Armcode / Arm Whois: affected 3.11

Credits: Yair Rodríguez Aparicio

References:
- https://www.exploit-db.com/exploits/45762 [exploit]
- http://www.armcode.com/ [product]
- http://www.armcode.com/downloads/arm-whois.exe [product]
- https://www.vulncheck.com/advisories/arm-whois-denial-of-service-via-buffer-overflow [third-party-advisory]

### CVE-2018-25427 — Arm Whois 3.11 Buffer Overflow via SEH Overwrite
- Assigner: VulnCheck | Published: 2026-06-01 | Updated: 2026-06-02 | Max CVSS: 9.8
- CWE: CWE-121 Stack-based Buffer Overflow
- CVSS 4.0 (cna): 9.3 CRITICAL `CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:H/VI:H/VA:H/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N`
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 9.8 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=total

Arm Whois 3.11 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code by supplying oversized input to the IP address or domain field. Attackers can craft malicious input exceeding 658 bytes with shellcode to overwrite the structured exception handler and gain command execution when the application processes the input.

Affected:
- Armcode / Arm Whois: affected 3.11

Credits: Yair Rodríguez Aparicio (0-day DoS exploit), Semen Alexandrovich Lyhin (1-day fully working exploit)

References:
- https://www.exploit-db.com/exploits/45796 [exploit]
- http://www.armcode.com/ [product]
- http://www.armcode.com/downloads/arm-whois.exe [product]
- https://www.vulncheck.com/advisories/arm-whois-buffer-overflow-via-seh-overwrite [third-party-advisory]

### CVE-2018-25432 — Arm Whois 3.11 Buffer Overflow via ASLR Bypass
- Assigner: VulnCheck | Published: 2026-06-01 | Updated: 2026-06-02 | Max CVSS: 8.6
- CWE: CWE-120 Buffer Copy without Checking Size of Input ('Classic Buffer Overflow')
- CVSS 4.0 (cna): 8.6 HIGH `CVSS:4.0/AV:L/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:H/VI:H/VA:H/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N`
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 8.4 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

Arm Whois 3.11 contains a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows local attackers to execute arbitrary code by overwriting the structured exception handler. Attackers can craft a malicious input file with a 672-byte offset to overwrite the nSEH and SEH pointers, enabling code execution through exception handler hijacking.

Affected:
- Armcode / Arm Whois: affected 3.11

Credits: zephyr

References:
- https://www.exploit-db.com/exploits/45907 [exploit]
- http://www.armcode.com [product]
- http://www.armcode.com/downloads/arm-whois.exe [product]
- https://www.vulncheck.com/advisories/arm-whois-buffer-overflow-via-aslr-bypass [third-party-advisory]
